title.en: Mobile API contracts: what to check after HTTP succeeds
title.zh: 移动端接口：HTTP 成功之后，还要判断什么

summary.en: Use HTML error pages, empty responses and stale-session 401s to examine the platform adapter and the limits of simulated tests.
summary.zh: 从 HTML 错页、空响应和旧会话的 401 出发，梳理接口适配层应承担的责任，以及模拟测试覆盖不到的地方。

basis.en: Based on public Shuyang Home v1.2.2 source, test fixtures and release records. Existing behavior, recorded checks and proposed tests are distinguished; this update is a source review and write-up.
basis.zh: 依据沭阳之家 v1.2.2 的公开源码、测试夹具与版本记录整理。文中区分已有实现、历史验证和建议补测；本次是代码阅读与内容整理。

title.en: An HTTP 200 can contain an HTML page
title.zh: HTTP 200 也可能返回一段 HTML

paragraphs.en: A mobile client can receive a proxy error page, a login page or a response from the wrong endpoint. A platform success callback means a response arrived; it does not mean response.data follows the application contract.
paragraphs.zh: 移动端可能连到了代理错误页、登录页或错误的服务地址。平台请求回调触发 success，只说明收到响应，不说明 response.data 符合业务约定。直接读取 data.code，会把传输问题和业务问题混在一起。

paragraphs.en: The current api adapter rejects null, strings, arrays and ArrayBuffer before checking for HTTP 2xx and code === 0. Rejection gives the page a chance to leave its loading state and display an error.
paragraphs.zh: 当前 api 适配器先排除 null、字符串、数组和 ArrayBuffer，再检查 HTTP 2xx 与 code === 0。异常分支调用 reject，让页面有机会结束加载并显示错误，而不是停在等待中。

callout.en: This checks only the response envelope. The api<T> generic does not prove at runtime that data.data satisfies T; amounts, permission fields and dates still need explicit validation.
callout.zh: 这只是响应外壳检查。api<T> 的泛型不会在运行时证明 data.data 满足 T；金额、权限字段或日期仍需要具体的边界校验。

title.en: A stale request must not sign out a new session
title.zh: 旧请求的 401 不应退出新账号

paragraphs.en: Consider this sequence: account A sends a request, the user switches to B, and A’s 401 arrives later. Clearing storage on every 401 would sign B out too.
paragraphs.zh: 一个容易忽略的顺序是：账号 A 发出请求，用户切换为账号 B，A 的 401 才回来。如果每次收到 401 都清空本地 token，B 也会被退出。

paragraphs.en: The adapter captures requestToken at dispatch. It clears the session and emits session-expired only when that token is nonempty and still equals the current token. Uploads and downloads need the same ownership check.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器在请求发出时保存 requestToken。只有请求携带的 token 非空，并且仍等于当前 token，才清理登录态并发出 session-expired 事件。上传和下载也需要相同的会话归属判断。

title.en: Network failure and session expiry need different actions
title.zh: 网络断开与登录失效是不同动作

paragraphs.en: An ordinary network failure should preserve the token. A short loss of connectivity should not force a new login. Requests currently use a 20-second timeout and transfers use 60 seconds; these are waiting limits, not performance targets.
paragraphs.zh: 普通网络失败不应删除 token。用户可能只是经过信号弱的区域，清除登录态会把短暂的连接问题变成重新登录的负担。当前请求设置 20 秒超时，上传与下载设置 60 秒超时；它们是等待上限，不是性能目标。

paragraphs.en: A shared error message is not a complete recovery strategy. Reading a list can be retried, but orders or messages require checking whether the server already processed the write. A missing response does not prove nothing happened.
paragraphs.zh: 统一错误提示解决不了所有恢复问题。列表可以重试读取，订单、消息等写操作还要确认服务端是否已处理，不能把“响应没收到”直接理解成“没有执行”。

bullets.en: Existing fixtures reject empty, HTML and malformed responses, and preserve the token on network failure.
bullets.zh: 已有夹具：空数据、HTML 字符串与异常响应应拒绝；网络失败保留 token。

bullets.en: Existing fixtures clear the current session on its own 401 while protecting a new token from an old response.
bullets.zh: 已有夹具：当前会话的 401 清理登录态；旧会话的 401 不影响新 token。

bullets.en: Proposed checks include missing or mistyped data.data fields, stale responses after signing in again, and different retry policies for reads and writes.
bullets.zh: 建议补测：data.data 字段缺失或类型错误、同账号重新登录后的旧响应，以及读写请求的不同重试策略。

callout.en: The 31 published mobile logic checks use mocked uni APIs and conditional-compilation preprocessing. They test response handling, not real WeChat containers, system keyboards, cameras or GPS.
callout.zh: 公开的 31 项移动端逻辑检查使用模拟 uni 接口与条件编译预处理。它们能检查响应逻辑，但不能替代微信容器、系统键盘、相机和 GPS 的真机验收。
